headline: Full strategy: not validated. Completed sessions: 25. Regime labels other than "none": transitional. Return per unit of drawdown 22.19 (earlier half 30.15, later half 50.51). 60/40 was -7.89. Buy-and-hold SPY was -7.26. The pre-set test needs the primary rule ahead of both on the full span and on each half, with more than one regime. That did not happen.
advice: This is research on past prices and on macro figures that had already been published. It is not proof the rule will keep working, and it is not financial advice.
limits: The share list is today's list. The 2021–2026 prices were already examined. CFTC positioning was left out. Caps, stops, sizing, and the live score windows were not changed. The 252-observation runs are variants: they pass a research-only credit window and do not change the live rule. Credit is never filled with another series when its own vintage is missing.

passCriteria.rule: H1 in research/regime-validation/PROTOCOL.md. Higher unit-NAV return per unit of drawdown than buy-and-hold SPY and the same-contribution 60% SPY / 40% cash mix, on the full span and on each half, in a sample with more than one regime label. Thresholds were not refit. Same-deposit SPY and VAS.AX are reported beside that test. They are not a new pass rule.

calendar.note: Portfolio dates are SPY sessions in the saved Yahoo book that still have a later ASX bar to fill. Some ALFRED vintages start earlier than those prices. The book cannot start before the prices.

dataGaps: Every requested series has ALFRED vintage dates. None were missing from ALFRED.

BAMLH0A0HYM2 vintage history is shallow and is not backfilled: first vintage is 2023-11-14, that vintage contains only the 2023-11-14 observation, and observations in this download run only from 2023-11-14 to 2026-11-12 (793 dates, 785 vintages). A 756-obs as-of window is first possible on 2026-10-01. Zero observations are available as-of 2012-01-01.

BAA10Y is in ALFRED and the first vintage (2014-01-27) does include history back to the 2008-01-01 download start (1518 numeric obs from 2008-01-02 to 2014-01-24, so a 756-obs window is ready on that first vintage date). But no vintage exists before 2014-01-27, so a fail-closed point-in-time replay has 0 BAA10Y observations as-of 2012-01-01. BAA10Y cannot supply a 756-obs PIT window before the 2012 replay start.

Other late-starting vintage histories (history is present in the first vintage, but PIT is fail-closed before that date): DFEDTARU 2014-04-03, T10Y2Y 2014-01-27, IPG3344S 2015-02-18, RRPONTSYD 2016-03-28, USALOLITOAASTSAM and AUSLOLITOAASTSAM 2018-07-17, DTWEXBGS 2019-02-04.

DGS2, DFF, DFII10, and WTREGEN have vintages before 2012 and usable PIT history as-of 2012-01-01. WALCL vintages start 2011-07-07 and already have 209 weekly points as-of 2012-01-01 (enough for the 13-week liquidity change; the 756 figure is the daily credit window, not the liquidity lookback).

USALOLITOAASTSAM, AUSLOLITOAASTSAM, and IPG3344S are monthly, so they never reach 756 observations in this sample (225 unique months). That 756 test applies to the daily credit z-score, not to these series.

variants.paragraph: Primary rule. The high-yield spread BAMLH0A0HYM2, 756-observation z-score. Completed 25 sessions, from 2026-10-02 to 2026-11-05. Skipped 1229 sessions. 508 sessions from 2021-11-08 to 2023-11-14: BAMLH0A0HYM2 has no ALFRED vintage as of the day before the decision. Credit stays fail-closed. 721 sessions from 2023-11-15 to 2026-10-01: BAMLH0A0HYM2 is short of the 756-observation credit window. Credit stays fail-closed. The capped AUD book, add-and-hold with the existing caps and a 0.10% one-way cost, compounded at 5.7% a year. Max drawdown 0.3%. Volatility 1.6%. Sharpe 3.36 with a risk-free rate of 0. Turnover 0.24. Invested on 100.0% of sessions. Same deposits over the same sessions: SPY -39.8% a year (drawdown 5.5%), VAS.AX 49.5% a year (drawdown 0.9%), and 60% SPY / 40% cash -26.0% a year (drawdown 3.3%). It finished ahead of SPY. It lagged VAS.AX. It finished ahead of the 60/40 mix. 25 sessions is a short sample. A compound annual rate over that span is not a meaningful test of the rule. On a completed day the credit score uses the last 756 observations. Shorter histories were skipped rather than scored. The live engine still starts a credit score at 252 observations, and the regime label can depend on that path. That minimum was not changed.
